timeline.text: My kids' phones block bad sites, but I had no idea what they actually visited.
It filtered blind — blocking requests, keeping no record of where they went.
And Android uses a different kind of private DNS, so it was invisible to the guard.
Now every device logs its sites and IPs on a new Cloudflare database, Android included.
I pick a device on the dashboard and see exactly where it went, for the last two days.
